result: An acquired exact/certified-approximate PI qubit MPO or symmetrized-Pauli description gives polynomial-arithmetic centralized sampling for arbitrary product POVMs by MPO contraction, regardless of separability. This does not acquire coefficients, provide a setting-independent positive product-state mixture, or physically prepare the state. Published PI coefficient/MPO and classical symmetry-processing precedents exist; no novelty claim for first classical simulation of the PI Gibbs family.
limitations: Targeted primary-source comparator, not exhaustive literature review.
The exact arbitrary-Gibbs-product-POVM sampling interface is derived from MPO contraction and not attributed as a separately published theorem.
Bit complexity depends on coefficient encoding, certified approximation, and numerical precision.
